ai.title: AI
ai.subtitle: Manage AI automation and catalog improvement.
ai.autoDisqualifyJunkHint: Let AI automatically move Junk-quality leads to Lost/Disqualified.
ai.autoEstimateHint: Let AI automatically estimate when a lead is ready for Estimation.
ai.autoDispatchHint: Let AI automatically match partners when a lead is ready for Fulfillment.
ai.confidenceGateEnabledHint: Keep leads in Nurturing when the intake analysis confidence is too low for estimation.
ai.adaptiveReasoningEnabledHint: Let the estimator switch between fast, balanced, and deliberate reasoning based on intake quality.
ai.experienceMemoryEnabledHint: Reuse recent AI outcomes and human quote corrections when generating new estimates.
ai.councilEnabledHint: Require governance checks before stage changes and draft quote creation.
ai.councilConsensusModeHint: Choose how strict council approval should be before AI actions are accepted.
ai.photoAnalysisPreprocessingEnabledHint: Prepare uploaded photos before analysis and attach preprocessing provenance to the AI run.
ai.photoAnalysisOcrAssistEnabledHint: Extract machine-read text candidates before full vision reasoning for allowed service types.
ai.photoAnalysisLensCorrectionEnabledHint: Apply best-effort lens correction before analysis for allowed service types.
ai.photoAnalysisPerspectiveNormalizationEna: Apply best-effort keystone normalization before analysis for allowed service types.
ai.photoAnalysisServiceTypesHint: Leave empty for all service types. Otherwise enter one service type per line or comma-separated.
